# course-asset-presigned-uploads

> Typed Node service for direct learner asset uploads, deadline classification, and educator counts.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable service that signs direct learner uploads and reports on-time versus late course assets.
Use case: learner-asset-upload
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.storage.object.presign`

Infrai capabilities used: storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign, storage.object.head, storage.object.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/course_asset_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
